senses.gloss:
वठ् वठ् (also written बठ्), cl. 1. P.
वठति, ववाठ (3rd pl. ववठुस्), व-
ठितुम्, to be large; to be powerful or able; to
be fat.

वठर वठर, अस्, आ, अम् (according to
Uṇādi-s. V. 39. fr. rt. वच् with substitution of ठ्
for च्), stupid, slow, dull; vile, wicked, abandoned
[cf. वटर]; (अस्), m. a fool, blockhead; a phy-
sician; a water-pot; = शब्द-कार; = वक्र.
